{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Antennae''' was an artifact of the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that had been missing for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], when recently-discovered radio waves pointed to it being located in the [[Fradian system/Legends|Fradian system]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Fine Tuning}}</ref>
